data.name: Mahnoorat
data.gender_notes: Mahnoorat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is full of grace and beauty. The name Mahnoorat carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mahnoorat usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mahnoorat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahnoorat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
